title: owners.yaml resolver response
description: The JSON object a resolver writes for a resolution request, keyed by normalized path. See SPEC.md section 7.

owners.description: The resolved owners, primary owner first. Empty when the path is unowned or unowned by design.

slack.description: The channel for the requested purpose.

source.description: The repository-relative path of the file that set the owners.

additions.description: The owners of additions at the path, separate from its owners. A resolver that predates the member leaves it out, and a consumer treats that as an empty array.
